name: Families
description: The sibling families that share the fund surplus

agentPrompts.label: Add a sibling family
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-fund` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add the sibling family I describe — name, head, and member count — so it can share in the fund's surplus. Write it through the trusted import process, never a direct Base write.

agentPrompts.label: Show each family's cumulative benefit and fairness
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-family-fund` skill in this folder, then show me each sibling family's cumulative benefit, share percentage, and deviation from the average — care cost excluded, shared costs split equally — so it's clear who is above or below the fairness threshold. Present this as a neutral fact, never advice on who should pay.
